$comment: Release self-declaration consumed by the unified registry's auto-core-release resolver (sh2-plugin-registry/scripts/resolve-core-candidate.mjs) at the git tag being released, and by this repo's release-descriptor step. supports.core is the semver range of core (backend) versions this frontend works with; while the platform is pre-1.0, every 0.x minor is breaking, so widen/bump it deliberately. Raise the lower bound whenever a frontend feature starts depending on a newer backend feature (e.g. a new/changed /cms-api endpoint or field-naming contract): the floor 0.1.17 is the first core release that emits the UNPREFIXED style field names this frontend reads after the field-naming unification (backend migration Version20260622165615 drops the `shared_` prefix from 47 style props - `shared_color`->`color`, `shared_variant`->`variant`, `shared_radius`->`radius`, ...; reserved `shared_height`/`shared_width`/`shared_icon` keep their prefix). That 0.1.17 floor also carries everything the previous 0.1.15 floor required - the mobile-rendering taxonomy (style `renderTarget`, required field `scope` driving inspector grouping, the unprefixed-common/web_/mobile_ field split with `pages.id_platform` removed in favour of the page access type) PLUS the alert/badge/avatar/button/login authoring-polish field set (alert `closable`; button/badge `variant`; badge `circle`; avatar `name`; login `subtitle`). This frontend (0.1.30) reads the unprefixed names via @selfhelp/shared >=1.14.22 (the prefix drop), so it MUST NOT be paired with a pre-0.1.17 core that still emits `shared_*`; the resolver refuses any incompatible frontend+backend pair in either direction. v0.1.30 also adds the anonymous-preview guard for the core >=0.1.18 behavior (an anonymous `preview=true` is now rejected with 401): preview is gated on a live session cookie and `sh_preview` is cleared on logout/expiry. That guard is backward-safe on older cores, so the `supports.core` floor previously stayed at 0.1.17. v0.1.31 adds the page-editor Mobile Preview panel, which mints a one-time preview code through the protected BFF route `POST /api/mobile-preview/session` -> core `POST /cms-api/v1/admin/mobile-preview/session`. That admin mint endpoint (plus the public `POST /mobile-preview/session/exchange` and the `MobilePreviewAccessGuard` read allowlist) first ships in core 0.1.19, so this floor is raised 0.1.17 -> 0.1.19 (the panel degrades to a graceful 'unavailable' state on older cores, but the version contract tracks the dependency). v0.1.32 adds the System Maintenance 'Update / enable mobile preview' lane (GET/POST /cms-api/v1/admin/system/update/mobile-preview/{releases,preflight,request}) and reads the new `mobile_preview_version` field from /admin/system/version; those endpoints + field first ship in core 0.1.20, so this floor is raised 0.1.19 -> 0.1.20 (the UI degrades gracefully on an older core, but the version contract tracks the dependency). v0.1.33 adds the full-screen CMS Live Preview surface (route `/admin/preview/[[...slug]]` + the editor 'Live preview' entry), gated on the new `admin.mobile_preview.view` permission; that permission is seeded (and granted to the admin role) by core migration Version20260623193630, first shipping in core 0.1.21, so this floor is raised 0.1.20 -> 0.1.21 (without it the route/entry degrade to no-access, but the version contract tracks the dependency). v0.1.34 reworks the Live Preview surface (one shared top-bar control set with Show Web/Show Mobile + a cookie-driven Draft toggle that also drives the same-origin web pane, plus an iframe lifecycle that unloads the frames when the tab is hidden or Stopped to free the dev server) and makes the login `dark`/`black` accent render adaptively so it stays readable in dark mode; both are floor-neutral (they reuse existing core endpoints/fields/permissions and add no new core dependency), so supports.core stays >=0.1.21. v0.1.35 redesigns the Live Preview into a single top control bar (frames-only canvas) and adds synchronized web<->mobile navigation via a postMessage preview bridge (the new @selfhelp/shared 1.15.2 contract; PreviewShellBridge mounted in the public website shell reports navigations + accepts soft navigate-to-keyword commands, loop-guarded), split web/mobile refresh keys, per-frame language handling, and hardened iframe sandboxing; it depends only on @selfhelp/shared >=1.15.2 and the selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.14 (which renders the matching mobile bridge + draft banner) and adds no new core dependency, so supports.core stays >=0.1.21. v0.1.36 fixes the Live Preview lifecycle (frames now unload only when the tab is hidden or Stopped, not on window blur / DevTools open), makes 'refresh mobile' a clean unmount->remount with a fresh session, mirrors the synced page into the master /admin/preview/<keyword> URL, and shows the in-frame mobile debug FAB; all floor-neutral (reuses existing core endpoints/fields/permissions), so supports.core stays >=0.1.21 (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.15). v0.1.37 rebuilds the Live Preview web pane as an INLINE render (no iframe) reusing the real public renderer (DynamicPageClient) + client-composed website chrome, with in-process navigation interception (PreviewNavigationContext makes InternalLink/ButtonStyle/LinkStyle drive the preview) replacing the web postMessage bridge, bidirectional /admin/preview/<keyword> URL mirroring, and in-app draft/language controls (web size selector + toolbar language picker removed); the mobile pane stays an iframe on the existing mint + preview bridge, so it adds no new core dependency and supports.core stays >=0.1.21 (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.15). v0.1.38 polishes that inline Live Preview: the mobile device controls (phone/tablet, portrait/landscape, mobile-only reload) move onto a floating pill over the mobile pane, the header avatar/profile menu navigation is routed through the same in-process preview interception (profile shows in both panes instead of unmounting the preview), and the mobile-only reload remounts the frame only once a fresh mint code is ready (fixing the perpetual-spinner wedge on the cross-origin Expo dev frame); all floor-neutral (reuses existing core endpoints/fields/permissions + the existing mint/preview-bridge contract), so supports.core stays >=0.1.21 (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.15). v0.1.39 shares theme + language across the two Live Preview panes over the @selfhelp/shared 1.15.3 preview bridge (pairs with selfhelp-mobile-preview image >=0.1.17). v0.1.40 makes language web-driven and URL-bound (the mobile frame remounts at the chosen locale) while theme keeps syncing live, fixing the language-change request storm that emptied the mobile menu. v0.1.41 persists the device-frame controls across a preview reload and makes 'Refresh both' invalidate the web page-content cache. v0.1.42 reorganises the controls into the top header (device/orientation/mobile-reload on the right; Mobile/Draft/Refresh/open-in-new-tab on the left). v0.1.43 restores the mobile device bezel and sizes the frame to the body minus its own chrome so the bottom tab bar is no longer clipped, and removes the now-stranded legacy web postMessage bridge (buildWebPreviewUrl + PreviewShellBridge) since the web pane renders inline. v0.1.44 adds the server-side same-origin `/mobile-preview/*` rewrite used by manager local mode; production Traefik still routes that path directly, so this is floor-neutral and supports.core stays >=0.1.21. v0.1.46 keeps the mobile iframe mounted across browser-tab visibility changes so navigation, scroll, and transient state survive; explicit mobile toggle/reload controls still own teardown, and the change adds no new core dependency, so supports.core stays >=0.1.21. v0.1.47 removes the no-op `sandbox` attribute from the mobile Live Preview iframe (trusted first-party content that needs both allow-scripts and allow-same-origin, which together negate the sandbox and only emitted the browser 'can escape its sandboxing' warning); floor-neutral, so supports.core stays >=0.1.21. v0.1.48 wires the data-table column field-key/display-name split (host issue #56): the admin column endpoints now return {id, fieldKey, displayName} instead of {id, name}, the section interpolation variables are fetched from a dedicated GET /cms-api/v1/admin/sections/{sectionId}/data-variables endpoint (a token => label map; the CMS variable picker inserts the immutable token but shows the human label), and a new PATCH /cms-api/v1/admin/data/tables/{tableName}/columns/display-name (permission admin.data.update_columns) curates labels; those contracts first ship in core 0.1.23, so this floor is raised 0.1.21 -> 0.1.23. v0.1.49 adds data-table + column display-name locking (host issue #56 follow-up): it consumes the new `locked` flag on the admin data-table list + column responses, the optional `data_table` block on GET /cms-api/v1/admin/sections/{sectionId} (getSection), and the new PATCH /cms-api/v1/admin/data/tables/{tableName}/display-name (permission admin.data.update_tables) that renames/locks a whole table; those contracts first ship in core 0.1.24, so this floor is raised 0.1.23 -> 0.1.24. v0.1.50 shares a single real-time SSE connection across all browser tabs (Web Locks leader election + BroadcastChannel fan-out for the /api/auth/events ACL stream and the /api/plugins/events plugin-manager stream) to stop the per-origin HTTP/1.1 connection-pool exhaustion that hung same-origin requests when several admin tabs were open; it reuses existing core SSE/Mercure endpoints and adds no new core dependency, so supports.core stays >=0.1.24. v0.1.51 makes modals dismissible only via their own close/cancel control by default (no close on outside click / Escape) and fixes the Data browser refresh (page-level Refresh now reloads rows from the whole admin/data cache; per-table background refetch is smooth via keepPreviousData instead of a full-card overlay); both are pure frontend UI fixes that add no new core dependency, so supports.core stays >=0.1.24. v0.1.52 adopts Interpolation v2 (host issue #56 v2): the variable picker/chip now treats the interpolation token as the immutable data-column `field_key` (e.g. `{{d.section_230}}`) while showing the human `display_name` as a label chip (chip renders the label, stores `{{field_key}}`, and re-parses `{{field_key}}` back into a chip on load), `{{` variable completion is added to markdown fields via a Monaco completion provider, and `show-user-input` headers default to the column `display_name` from the new section `field_labels` map (`field_key => display_name`) with `fields_map` as an override. The render-time `retrieved_data` scope is now keyed by `field_key` and `show-user-input` ships `field_labels` only from core 0.1.25 (DataVariableResolver token->field_key + SectionUtilityService field_labels), so this floor is raised 0.1.24 -> 0.1.25; pre-release wipe means no migration of old name-based tokens. Pairs with @selfhelp/shared >=1.17.1 (the `IShowUserInputStyle.field_labels` type). The resolver refuses any incompatible frontend+backend pair in either direction. v0.1.53 completes Interpolation v2 by making the picker modular and global: a single `useInterpolationVariables(context, id)` hook + `<InterpolationField>`-style wiring fetch the catalog from the new unified core endpoint GET /cms-api/v1/admin/interpolation/variables (context = section|page|action|global), the section hook now delegates to it, and the `{{ }}` picker is wired into the page/config text fields, the action subject/body editors (recipient.*/record.<field_key>/system.*), the data-config SQL filter, and the custom CSS/Mobile-CSS + JSON Monaco editors (the `{{` completion provider now covers css/json, not just markdown). Because the frontend now resolves variables (including section ones) through the unified endpoint, it requires the core route that first ships in 0.1.26, so this floor is raised 0.1.25 -> 0.1.26 (backend `supports.frontend` stays >=0.1.52: the route is additive and the legacy section data-variables route still exists). v0.1.54 completes the type-driven CMS editor wave (host issue #56): the data-config builder now renders the always-present standard projection columns (id/id_users/user_name/record_id/entry_date/id_users_deleted, flagged standard:true/id:null/locked:true) that the admin columns endpoint prepends, the section editor chooses the editor purely from the field type (text = single-line mention input; markdown-inline = single-line + inline marks; textarea = rich WYSIWYG that accepts Enter for multiline/lists/headings; json/code/css/markdown/SQL = Monaco, with the new `code` type opening raw HTML), the data-config SQL filter is a lockable Monaco editor, the mail-config bodies persist the email `email-*` style presets on the real a/p/h elements (a global-attribute Tiptap extension, so reseeded mails keep their styling), `{{token}}` hydration runs only inside visible text nodes (a token inside an href/attribute stays literal so mail links are not broken), and the condition-builder datetime picker portals above the modal. The standard-columns response shape + the new `code`/retyped field types first ship in core 0.1.27, so this floor is raised 0.1.26 -> 0.1.27 (backend `supports.frontend` is raised to >=0.1.54 in lockstep). v0.1.55 renders the BLOCK structure of the now-rich `text`/`blockquote` display fields (TextStyle/BlockquoteStyle emit the authored headings/lists/paragraphs/alignment via a hydration-safe block sanitizer instead of flattening them to inline; Mantine `<Text>` becomes a `component="div"` only when the content has markup), ships the closable field-help popover (formatted JSON/code examples + a copy button), groups the mail-config editor into Subject+Body cards per e-mail, lets the single-line mention editor wrap/grow instead of horizontal-scrolling, and raises the condition-builder datetime picker z-index above the modal. The retyped `text`/`blockquote_content` fields (markdown-inline -> textarea) first ship in core 0.1.28, so this floor is raised 0.1.27 -> 0.1.28 (backend `supports.frontend` is raised to >=0.1.55 in lockstep). v0.1.56 is a floor-neutral CMS-authoring fix: the data-config builder's Scope field becomes a plain text input (it is the interpolation scope identifier, not interpolated content) and the last/only data source can now be removed (saving zero data sources clears the data_config); both are UI-only and add no new core dependency, so supports.core stays >=0.1.28. v0.1.57 adopts DB-driven public routing (host issue #30): the catch-all route now turns the slug into a path and resolves the page server-side via the new open-access endpoint GET /cms-api/v1/pages/resolve (replacing client-side keyword parsing), the reset-password/validate styles read the resolved {{route.user_id}}/{{route.token}} params instead of parsing the URL, and the admin Pages list gains the portable page export/import dialog + the 'Create list + detail pages' CMS-in-CMS wizard (POST /admin/pages/export|import|cms-app). Because every public page is now resolved through /pages/resolve, which first ships in core 0.1.31, this floor is raised 0.1.28 -> 0.1.31 (backend supports.frontend is raised to >=0.1.57 in lockstep). Pairs with @selfhelp/shared >=1.18.0 (route-metadata types + PAGES.RESOLVE endpoint). v0.1.59 is the navigation-overhaul wave (strict nav contract v2): it consumes the rewritten GET /cms-api/v1/navigation payload (strict always-present item keys incl. description/aria_label/layer; menu-level preset/max_depth/item_limit; config removed), the admin navigation payloads with `layer` + footer presets (columns/inline as presets, not config.footer_layout), and the strict selfhelp/navigation-bundle v2.0 export/import (v1.0 rejected); those contracts first ship in core 0.1.33, so this floor is raised 0.1.32 -> 0.1.33 (backend supports.frontend is raised to >=0.1.59 in lockstep). Pairs with @selfhelp/shared 1.21.5 (strict INavigationMenu/INavigationMenuItem, headerLayers/footerPreset/activeTrail helpers, bundle v2.0 types; wave previously staged as shared 2.0.0). v0.1.60 adopts first-class CMS apps (GET/POST /admin/cms-apps*, admin.cms_app.* permissions, removes POST /admin/pages/cms-app); those contracts first ship in core 0.1.34, so this floor is raised 0.1.33 -> 0.1.34 (backend supports.frontend is raised to >=0.1.60 in lockstep). v0.1.62 adopts field-based entry-list/entry-record binding, the column mapper + fields-map editors, and POST /admin/data/query-preview filter preview UI; those contracts first ship in core 0.1.35, so this floor is raised 0.1.34 -> 0.1.35 (backend supports.frontend is raised to >=0.1.62 in lockstep). v0.1.63 adopts entry-record load_record_from (same contract as entry-record-form; author SQL filter removed from entry-record) and pins @selfhelp/shared 1.21.7 — the DB-routing / CMS-apps / navigation / entry-binding wave previously staged on the feature branch as shared 2.0.0–3.0.1 was republished as 1.21.5 then cleanup 1.21.6. Those contracts first ship in core 0.1.36, so this floor is raised 0.1.35 -> 0.1.36 (backend supports.frontend is raised to >=0.1.63 in lockstep). Do not treat shared 2.x/3.x as the current pin; active pin is 1.21.7. v0.1.64 reworks the Users Management page (stat tiles, status/group filters, bulk add-to-group/send-activation/delete, CSV export/import) onto seven new core endpoints: GET /admin/users/stats, the `status` + `id_groups` filter params on GET /admin/users, POST /admin/users/{bulk-delete,bulk-add-to-group,bulk-remove-from-group,bulk-send-activation}, GET /admin/users/export and POST /admin/users/import. The page reads `IUsersStats` {total,active,invited,blocked} (scoped to the caller's visible users, so `total` equals the unfiltered list totalCount for that admin; `blocked` wins over status and the legacy `interested`/`auto_created` codes count in `total` but no bucket, so the tiles are four independent counts and MUST NOT be rendered as a breakdown that sums) and the shared {succeeded,failed[{id,reason}]} bulk-result shape that reports partial failures per user. Those contracts first ship in core 0.1.37, so this floor is raised 0.1.36 -> 0.1.37 (backend supports.frontend is raised to >=0.1.64 in lockstep).
